definitions: A suite of cloud-based software services offered by Salesforce, encompassing various products like Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, etc.
The overarching platform provided by Salesforce that delivers customer relationship management (CRM) and related applications through the internet.
examples: Many businesses leverage Salesforce Cloud for their CRM needs.
The new integration enhances our use of Salesforce Cloud.
Training on Salesforce Cloud is essential for the sales team.
